name: onstage
description: Obsidian plugin: live slide projection of a note you keep editing.

scripts.test: esbuild test/parser.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=test/.out/parser.test.js --log-level=warning && node test/.out/parser.test.js && esbuild test/props.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --alias:obsidian=./test/stub-obsidian.ts --external:@codemirror/* --outfile=test/.out/props.test.js --log-level=warning && node test/.out/props.test.js && esbuild test/follow.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --alias:obsidian=./test/stub-obsidian.ts --external:@codemirror/* --outfile=test/.out/follow.test.js --log-level=warning && node test/.out/follow.test.js && esbuild test/scenario.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --alias:obsidian=./test/stub-obsidian.ts --external:@codemirror/* --outfile=test/.out/scenario.js --log-level=warning && node test/.out/scenario.js
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
